title: Tax Setting
description:
You can use Tax `Settings` to manage configurations used by Stripe Tax calculations.

Related guide: [Using the Settings API](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/settings-api)

head_office.description: The place where your business is located.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

status.description: Whether these settings have the information Stripe Tax needs to calculate tax. It doesn't reflect whether your integration is ready to collect tax.
